source.check: page image read in the viewer: 'There was no contest after all for Clogher Rural Council and Guardians, Mr. James E. Hackett, the sitting member for Cullamore division having been given a walk-over by the withdrawal of his opponent, Mr. James Gormley'

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received on 5 May 1936; Cullamore had two Nationalist nominations, the sitting member, Mr. James E. Hackett, and Mr. James Gormley (Belfast News-Letter, 6 May 1936, p. 9; Irish News, 6 May 1936, p. 7). Mr. Gormley withdrew, so there was no contest in the district and Mr. Hackett had a walk-over (Impartial Reporter, 21 May 1936, p. 5). Polling in County Tyrone was fixed for Wednesday 3 June 1936; no poll was needed. Returned unopposed.
